brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Four bases: piece:0,0,0;half-s + piece:1,0,0;half-s at level 0 and piece:0,0,1;half-s + piece:1,0,1;half-s at level 1 forming two-storey organizer
Two bins bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full and bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full placed on level 1 top cells, staged with tools
Notch drawer frame notch:1#0,1#notch1 between the two upper cells at level 1, provides drawer storage below bin rim; drawer sockets only offered at level 1 for half-s bases
capOpenFaces applied caps cap:0,0,1;#;90 etc., lockJoints run; check_build ok meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built two-storey workbench organizer from half-s bases, two full bins on top level and a notch drawer between them, all open faces capped and joints locked. Dressed with workshop tools to show purpose.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
